purpose: Concrete source-only handoff for Bag End playable interior hub without asserting Unreal import or testing

production_groups.placement: authored modular interior; do not imply source exists
production_groups.collision: simple blocking for walls/floor; doorway/companion clearance; separate door trigger

production_groups.placement: readable lanes between entry, table, hearth and pantry
production_groups.collision: hero furniture simple collision; clutter no expensive collision

production_groups.placement: story state and interaction registry must own stable IDs; avoid raw world hard references
production_groups.collision: interaction volumes never block walkable passage

production_groups.placement: localized attenuation; limit simultaneous emitters; avoid dynamic shadow proliferation

requirements: camera sightline to interactable hero slot

runtime_contract.streaming: FStreamableManager async; no synchronous heavy LoadObject
runtime_contract.crowds: pooled ambient NPCs, no dense Spawn/Destroy
runtime_contract.state_owner: LivingWorldDirector owns population and microevents; ShireNPCContextSubsystem owns NPC context/dialogue/schedule
runtime_contract.working_set: region/zone residency bounded for target ~2GB VRAM and 8GB RAM

source_asset_rules.mesh_delivery: FBX only for UE import; derived repairs on copies
source_asset_rules.textures: PNG/TGA, channel-packed masks when appropriate; default 1K/2K
source_asset_rules.receipts: source URI/licensing, SHA256, derived SHA256, slot and UV QC before import
source_asset_rules.reject_as_imported_without: real UE4.27 exact-head import receipt and Asset Registry proof

five_lane_handoff.WAREHOUSE_ASSET_INTAKE: resolve each furniture/architecture/material source to a licensed SHA256 receipt
five_lane_handoff.VISUAL_WORLD_PREP: Blender derivative static meshes, UV0, smoothing, material slots, LOD/collision and room anchor manifest
five_lane_handoff.SKELETAL_CHARACTER_PREP: Bilbo, Gandalf and Frodo animation candidates and scale/deformation review
five_lane_handoff.GAMEPLAY_PRESENTATION_PREP: stable interaction IDs, state-specific objectives, original English VO and Arabic RTL subtitle keys
five_lane_handoff.RUNTIME_BUILD: blocked on self-hosted UE4.27 import/compile and chapter Gate 6/7
